newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar settles higher and in range.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar settles higher and in range.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed firmer and near session highs as prices retraced some of the losses made during the previous session.
Trading sources said many players kept to the sidelines in the wake of huge price swings in the past week and before the last trading day for May sugar on April 30.
The most-active July contract traded from a high of 11.37 cents a lb hit on Wednesday to a low of 10.91 cents Thursday.
Today's action focused on rolling of May positions. Prices are expected to remain within the current range through delivery period, traders said.
Support for July was pegged at 11.00 cents and then at Thursday's low of 10.91 cents, where sell stops are expected to be resting.
Producer selling is likely to limit gains over 10.20 cents basis July, traders said.
Most-active July contract closed 0.07 cent firmer at 11.14 cents, having ranged from 11.15 to 10.98 cents. May ended 0.09 higher at 11.55, while the back months settled 0.09 to 0.11 higher.
Estimated volume reached 19,614 lots on the day.
Open interest in May fell 3,499 lots to 26,307 lots as of early Thursday. July lost 1,763 lots to 85,471 lots.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
